title: arrhenatherum elatius var. precatorium
intro: Arrhenatherum elatius var. precatorium, commonly known as Meadow Sweet, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Western Asia. The health benefits of Meadow Sweet include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe sore throats and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Sweet include its ability to act as a demulcent and astringent, providing relief from coughs and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Meadow Sweet include flavonoids, coumarins, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
